vivian: heads-up: customer reported duplicated confirmed charges when a streaming session that invoked a toolcall got truncated client-side and the client reconnected via a different region. reproduced on staging.

lee: can you drop the minimal trace and what the ledger shows?

vivian: trace (sanitized): ```STREAM_START id=stg-42 model=gpt-pro seq=0
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=40 prefix="Ship"
TOOLCALL start id=tc-21
STREAM_TRUNCATE reason=client_close
LEDGER provisional tokens=40 session=stg-42 note=stream_partial
RECONNECT via router=eu-1 session=stg-42-1
STREAM_CHUNK seq=1 tokens=40 prefix="Ship"
LEDGER confirmed tokens=40 session=stg-42-1 note=resume_confirm
```

omar: so provisional 40 then confirmed 40 but provisional never reconciled/cleared -> double confirmed on invoice?

tina: my read: the resume hit a router that didn't see the provisional tombstone because ownership of provisional entries is cached per-router with eventual consistency. confirm path creates a new confirmed row instead of attaching.

lee: quick mitigation candidates: (A) attach-on-confirm by continuity token (opaque id authored at provisional write and carried by router headers on resume) (B) best-effort fuzzy match by (customer, prefix_fingerprint, time window) (C) UI visibility for provisional rows so support can triage and refund.

vivian: prefer A + C. A requires plumbing a continuity_token into provisional writes and having resume requests forward it. If absent, fallback to B.

omar: DB design: store continuity_token on provisional row with short TTL (e.g., 5m). Confirm writer attempts transactional attach: SELECT FOR UPDATE provisional WHERE continuity_token = X; if found and unattached -> attach; else create confirmed. This avoids races.

tina: for fuzzy match B: require prefix_fingerprint (8 bytes) in chunk telemetry and allow match only if confirmed_tokens <= provisional_tokens * 1.05 (small leeway). Otherwise don't dedupe.

lee: console needs a new "billing:provisional" view and a per-session badge (provisional/attached/confirmed). Support team should be able to open trace from the provisional row and mark dispute.

vivian: telemetry: emit provisional.orphan.count, provisional.attach.rate, unmatched_confirm.count. Add alert if unmatched_confirm spikes > 3/min for 15m. This is revenue-impacting so page on-call with rate limits.

omar: rollout plan: feature-flag continuity_token and transactional attach; start 1% traffic in canary region, monitor metrics and errors. Add an async reconcile job that scans orphan provisionals older than TTL and attempts fuzzy match to confirmed rows as a safety net.

tina: important: quotas. Currently provisional decrements quota immediately. If we later attach, that should not double-decrement. We need to keep a soft_quota decrement on provisional and only commit to hard_quota on confirmed attach. That's a larger product discussion; for now flagging to billing/product.

lee: I'll open infra + api tickets. vivian will PR the prefix_fingerprint change to streaming schema (short fixed64). omar will own provisional table changes. tina will draft console mockups and the support runbook.

ingress-bot: canary rollout scheduled: continuity-token-upstream -> 2024-07-02T09:30:00Z -> 1% traffic (eng-eu).

billing-bot: created ticket BILL-2042 "Provisional billing visibility + continuity token attach" assign: billing, eng-platform, console.

vivian: thx all. please keep any customer escalations in this thread and ping me for urgent refunds.
